API definition for CRUD operations on Virtual Entities. In the Glow Platform a Virtual Entity, is the virtual representation of a physical “thing” that is comprised of metadata and a collection of resources that define and describe it. An example of a Virtual Entity is a home with electricity energy readings sourced from a smart meter.
